explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/23: can every triangle-free graph on 5n vertices be made bipartite by deleting at most n² edges? The statement quantifies over V : Type of card 5n and triangle-free G, giving a bipartite H ≤ G with |E(G) \ E(H)| ≤ n². It is open, matching the page (best known 1.064n²). Faithful.
